SELECT FN_MAKE_PAYMENT_CODE() FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_CODE, SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE, PAYMENT_STAT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_DATE, CARD_COMPANY, RECENT_PAYMENT, NEXT_PAYMENT, BILLING_START, BILLING_END, PAYMENT_KEY, ORDER_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{paymentCode}, #{subCode}, #{companyCode}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentStat}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentDate}, #{cardCompany}, #{recentPayment}, #{nextPayment}, #{billingStart}, #{billingEnd}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{createdBy}, #{createDate}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.COMPANY_CODE, s.CURRENT_PRICE, s.CURRENT_USER_COUNT, s.PLAN_CODE, s.SUBS_START, s.SUBS_END, s.SUB_CODE, s.SUBS_STATUS, st.CODE_NAME AS inactiveReasonName FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER c JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE s ON c.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE JOIN TB_CM_CODE st ON st.CODE = s.INACTIVE_REASON WHERE SUBS_STATUS = 'INACTIVE' ORDER BY c.COMPANY_CODE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.sub_code, s.company_code, s.plan_code, s.subs_start, s.subs_end, s.subs_status, s.current_price, s.current_user_count, s.billing_period, p.price, pay.payment_method, pay.recent_payment, pay.next_payment, pay.payment_stat, s.created_by, s.create_date, s.updated_by, s.update_date FROM TB_SUBSCRIBE s JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE_PLAN p ON p.plan_code = s.plan_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sub_code, payment_method, recent_payment, next_payment, payment_stat FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.sub_code ORDER BY t.recent_payment DESC) rn FROM TB_PAYMENT t ) WHERE rn = 1 ) pay ON pay.sub_code = s.sub_code WHERE s.company_code = #{companyCode} AND s.subs_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.subs_start <= SYSDATE AND s.subs_end >= SYSDATE ORDER BY s.subs_start DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT PAYMENT_CODE, SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ORDER_ID, TOTAL_PRICE, PAYMENT_STAT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_DATE, CARD_COMPANY, PAYMENT_KEY, RECENT_PAYMENT, NEXT_PAYMENT, BILLING_START, BILLING_END, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE FROM TB_PAYMENT WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ORDER BY PAYMENT_DATE DESC
